name: StickyActionBar
whenToUse: Save / Discard at the end of a long form, kept in view while scrolling.
Bulk actions for a selection (`variant="floating"`) — appears when something is selected.
The primary button of a mobile screen.

whenNotToUse.text: Short forms where the buttons are already in view

anatomy.description: “3 selected”, “Unsaved changes” — announced when it changes.

do.caption: Says what the actions apply to.
do.example:
<BarMock message="3 selected">
  <Button appearance="outlined" tone="secondary" size="md">Export</Button>
  <Button appearance="filled" tone="danger" size="md">Delete</Button>
</BarMock>

dont.caption: Without the count, “Delete” could mean anything.
dont.example:
<BarMock message="">
  <Button appearance="outlined" tone="secondary" size="md">Export</Button>
  <Button appearance="filled" tone="danger" size="md">Delete</Button>
</BarMock>

a11y: It’s a labelled landmark (“Actions” by default); the message is a polite live region.
Closed means not rendered — no hidden tab stops.
Keep the end of the page reachable: the bar covers the content under it.

props.name: message
props.description: Status on the start side; announced politely when it changes.

props.name: position
props.description: `sticky` (default) pins to the bottom of the nearest scroll container; `fixed` to the viewport.
